name: REACT
source:
"I-I can't afford to die," muttered Toya, a descendant of the Amagi family who ran a Youkai extermination shop. For him, exterminating youkai is a job and a means of revenge.

Amagi Shinichirou was killed by a Youkai ten years ago. In order to avenge the man who was his own father, Touya goes out to exterminate Youkai with the demon "Kikou" today as well, but he is unable to catch his enemy's tail.

However, one day, a youkai called "Seku" appeared in front of him. Seku, who had the
appearance of a human boy, spoke to Toya with a meaningful smile., "... 10 years ago."

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-story]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我、我可不能死。”曾家经营妖怪除治铺的后代Touya喃喃自语。对他而言，除治妖怪既是一份工作，也是一种复仇手段。

Amagi Shinichirou在10年前被妖怪杀害。为了替自己的父亲报仇，Touya今天也和名为“Kikou”的恶魔一起外出除治妖怪，但始终找不到仇人的踪迹。

然而有一天，一个名为“Seku”的妖怪出现在他面前。Seku看起来像个男孩，带着意味深长的笑容对Touya说道：“……10年前。”

[译自[url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-story]官方网站[/url]]
